description: Contains the nameplate information attached to the product.

items.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text in multiple languages. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

Text.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

AdressInformation.description: Contains information on how to contact the manufacturer or an authorised service provider, e.g. when a maintenance service is required.

StreetName.description: Street name of the building where an organization is located (IEC 61360-7).

StreetNo.description:
Identification number of an entrance to a building related to a domain defined by the street as issued by the local authorities.

    synonym: house number

PostalCode.description: ZIP/postal code of the area in which an organization is located.

CityName.description: City or town where the company or organization is located.

CountryCode.description:
Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code)

	NOTE: a value list with all country codes is available in IEC CDD, IRDI 0112/2///61360_7#CEA008#001

MimeType.description: A MIME type as defined in RFC 2046, for example "application/pdf".

FileWithContentType.description: A file is a data element that represents an address to a file (a locator). The value is a URI that can represent an absolute or relative path.

value.description:
Path and name of the file (with file extension).

The path can be absolute or relative.

contentType.description: Content type of the content of the file or blob.

TypeOfConformityRegulation.description:
Classification of a certificate or approval document according to the regulations against which the conformity of an entity is tested (IEC 61360-7).
	
	synonym: MarkingName

IdentifierOfCertificate.description:
Alphanumeric character sequence identifying a certificate, approval, declaration or license (EC 61360-7).

    NOTE: to be entered without spaces 

    synonym: DesignationOfCertificateOrApproval

CertificateSupplement.description: Running number or designation of a supplement/amendment issued to an existing certificate, approval, declaration or license.

DateOfIssue.description: Date, at which the specified certificate is issued. Note: format by lexical representation: CCYY-MM-DD. Note: to be specified to the day.

EndOfValidity.description: Date, at which the specified certificate expires. Note: format by lexical representation: CCYY-MM-DD. Note: to be specified to the day.

AdditionalMarkingText.description: Where applicable, additional information on the marking in plain text, e.g. the ID-number of the notified body involved in the conformity process.

Markings.description: Note: CE marking is declared as mandatory according to EU Blue Guide.

UniqueProductIdentifier.description:
Unique global identification of the product (physical instance) using a uniform resource identifier (URI).
   
   Unique string of characters for the identification of a product, that also enables a web link to the digital product passport.
   
   ID conformant to EN 18219:2026.

   SOURCE: EN 18223:2026(en)

ProductBatchOrLotId.description: Unique global identification of a product batch or lot using an uniform resource identifier (URI).

ProductTypeId.description: Unique global identification of a product type using an uniform resource identifier (URI).

ManufacturerName.description: Legally valid designation of the natural or judicial person which is directly responsible for the design, production, packaging and labeling of a product in respect to its being brought into circulation.

ManufacturerId.description: Fully qualified domain name of the manufacturer of a product using a uniform resource identifier (URI).

TypeNameOfProduct.description: Top level of a 3 level manufacturer specific product hierarchy.

FamilyNameOfProduct.description: 2nd level of a 3 level manufacturer specific product hierarchy.

ModelNameOfProduct.description: Short description of the product (short text), third or lowest level of a 3 level manufacturer specific product hierarchy.

CodeOfProduct.description: Characteristic to differentiate between different products of a product family or special variants.

OrderCodeOfProduct.description: Unique combination of numbers and letters used to identify the device for ordering.

ArticleNumber.description: Unique product identifier of the manufacturer.

SerialNumber.description: Unique combination of numbers and letters used to identify the device once it has been manufactured.

DateOfManufacture.description: Date when an item was manufactured.

HardwareVersion.description: Version of the hardware supplied with the device.

FirmwareVersion.description: Version of the firmware supplied with the device.

SoftwareVersion.description: Version of the software used by the device.

CountryOfOrigin.description: Country where the product was manufactured. Note: Country codes defined accord. to DIN EN ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.

FacilityId.description:
Unique string of characters for the identification of locations or buildings involved in a product's value chain or used by actors  involved in a product's life cycle.
   
   String formatted according to EN 18219:2026.

   SOURCE: EN 18223:2026(en)

CompanyLogo.description: A graphic mark used to represent a company, an organisation or a product.

Markings.description: Markings of the product. Note: CE marking is declared as mandatory according to EU Blue Guide.
